body.statement: On the submodel \(U_1=U_2=0\) almost surely, the factorization becomes \(F_x(s,t)=p_x\varphi_{f,x}(s+t)\) and \(G_x(s,t)=p_x\varphi_{q,x}(s+t)\), while the identified ADRF remains \(\mu(a)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_xE_P[Y\mid A=a,X=x]\), the standard continuous-treatment g-formula.
body.justification: The reduction checks that the blind-replicate construction preserves the established causal target when measurement error vanishes.
body.gap: The result is a required sanity reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Implementations can be unit-tested against the ordinary error-free ADRF functional.
